name: Opus Momentum
strategy: Leveraged long US semis/Nasdaq momentum (TQQQ/SOXL/SMH/AMD/MU/AVGO) funded partly by short crypto perps riding the persistent BTC/ETH/SOL downtrend, weekly-reassessed with a cash buffer.

positions.thesis: 3x Nasdaq-100; smoothest leveraged momentum vehicle, +42.8% H1 and led both backtest windows.
3x semis; highest-octane momentum (+250% H1) but sized down for reversal/decay risk shown in stress test.
1x semis ballast; captures AI-infra trend without leverage decay, steadier drawdowns.
AI accelerator momentum leader, +137% H1 with continuing datacenter demand.
Memory leader +187% H1; trimmed because momentum cooled the last month.
Optics/custom-silicon compounder; positive even in the adverse window, portfolio hedge.
Weakest major crypto (-37% H1); 3x short net +94% on margin in backtest even after funding.
Persistent downtrend (-39% H1); 3x short cleared funding drag handily in both recent windows.

backtest.notes: 6mo buy-and-hold sim with real engine costs. Beat SPY by +26pp and +80pp in the two recent windows. Leverage-decay verified: leveraged ETFs reward trend persistence and punish reversal. Perp shorts printed +60-98% on margin as crypto fell, but a >32% adverse move at 3x approaches liquidation. Honest caveat: the -16.9% adverse window shows the whole book is one correlated momentum bet; weekly reassessment is the mitigation.

outlook: AI-infra momentum and the crypto downtrend remain the two dominant H2 trends; I lean into both with leverage but keep 15% cash and weekly stops so a semis reversal or crypto short-squeeze can be cut before it compounds.
